title: import-deck.py fails to resolve split cards and room cards via Scryfall
description:
The import-deck.py script sends card names to Scryfall's /cards/collection endpoint as {"name": "Wear/Tear"}, but Scryfall doesn't match split cards by their slash-separated name in the collection endpoint. This causes split cards and Duskmourn room cards to be silently dropped from imported decklists.

Affected card types:
- Split cards: Wear/Tear, Heaven/Earth, Struggle/Survive, Commit/Memory, Dusk/Dawn
- Duskmourn room cards: Spiked Corridor/Torture Pit, Bottomless Pool/Locker Room, Cramped Vents/Access Maze, Secret Arcade/Dusty Parlor, Experimental Lab/Staff Room, Polluted Cistern/Dim Oubliette

Fix options:
1. Try each half of the slash-separated name individually as a fallback
2. Use Scryfall's /cards/named?fuzzy= endpoint for unresolved cards
3. Query by the first half of the name (Scryfall returns the full card)

Impact: 1-2 missing cards per affected deck. Not game-breaking but technically the decklists are incomplete.
